title: Blue House
content: My “mall world” is The Blue House. Three stories. 2nd floor is full of garbage bags (presumably of papers and old things) but I am absolutely terrified to look in the trash bags. The ceiling is usually leaky. I can’t even go on the 3rd floor because I just can’t force myself to. Sometimes THB isn’t blue but is stone instead. Very old stone. Leaky roof still. It’s always a fixer upper… I’ve either bought the house in an abandoned state or inherited it. All of the prior owner’s stuff is still inside. It makes me uneasy. I like the place but I don’t feel like the place likes me. I go to one of these two houses in most of my dreams. I feel that someone else goes there too. I have drawn out the floor plans many times. I am starting to feel more at home there than out here, which doesn’t feel too great.
